svg.title: Exchanger coil - prototype 2 vs 3
svg.text: Exchanger coil in its concrete block
Prototype 2 has one 3 m tube. Prototype 3 doubles it, to measure how heat output scales with surface area.
Shares of the total thermal resistance at realistic values (h_compost 15, Al 3 mm, h_water 3000 W/m²K)
So copper or a thinner wall changes nothing. More contact area, or moving air past the tube, does.
